messages:
Maya Patel: quick heads-up — PR 35678 is hitting intermittent failures on linux-x86 shard 7 in integ-scheduler. Failing test: SchedulerAllocation.test_preemptive_rebalance. It passes locally for me. Can someone give quick eyes? I'm deciding whether to update a snapshot or rerun.
Jon Rivera: link the CI output? also what changed in the PR briefly?
Maya Patel: https://ci.redwood.local/builds/35678/7 — relevant snippet:
```
AssertionError: expected 3 allocations, got 2
at SchedulerAllocationTest.java:142
...
```
PR is a small change to the host rebalancer timing (adds a 5ms jitter) to reduce GC contention.
Alice Chen: looks like a timing nondet. If it flakes due to race, increasing the test timeout or adding a brief wait in setup helped in past. Do we have reproducer steps?
Maya Patel: I can try a local loop with --reproduce 100. Planning a targeted rerun of only shard 7 first to see if CI repros. :eyes: 
Sam Brooks: I can take a look in ~30m. If it's transient, we usually don't update snapshots — better to rerun a few times then bisect if stable failure.
ci-bot: rerun request received: targeted-rerun shard=7 for build=35678 by user=Maya Patel
Maya Patel: kicking off targeted rerun now.
ci-bot: targeted rerun started for build=35678 shard=7 (run id 35678-7-r2)
Maya Patel: first targeted rerun result — PASSED. Rerunning once more to be safe.
ci-bot: targeted rerun started for build=35678 shard=7 (run id 35678-7-r3)
Maya Patel: second rerun — PASSED as well. So 2/2 on reruns, original run had 1/3 fails. I'll not update snapshots. Tagging for approval: please +1 when you can, Sam/Jon.
Jon Rivera: if it stays green on retries, I'm fine with merging. Recommend adding a small comment in the test referencing the jitter change so future flakiness is easier to investigate. :thumbsup:
Alice Chen: agree. Also if it crops up again, let's add flaky-test label and schedule a bisect. I'll leave a quick suggestion in the PR.
Sam Brooks: +1 — merge when CI is green again. I'll follow up on a longer-term flaky test triage next week.
Maya Patel: thanks all — merging when the merge queue opens. cc @ci-bot to watch.
ci-bot: merge queue updated: PR 35678 queued (verify status will be re-checked prior to merge)
